about.title: Dr. AlHasan: The Art & Science of Aesthetic Excellence
about.subtitle: Over Two Decades of Distinguished Practice in Plastic Surgery
about.bio1: Dr. AlHasan is a renowned plastic surgeon with over twenty years of experience in aesthetic surgery. He graduated with honors from Cairo University Faculty of Medicine and completed his specialized training at leading international medical centers.
about.bio2: He holds a fellowship from the Royal College of Surgeons of England, along with multiple certifications from international aesthetic surgery societies. His reputation is built on delivering natural, refined results that combine artistic vision with clinical precision.
about.bio3: Dr. AlHasan specializes in facial rejuvenation, rhinoplasty, and body contouring procedures. He is known for his unique approach that respects each patient's individual features, aiming to enhance confidence through natural-looking outcomes that exceed expectations.

faq.title: Answers to Your Most Common Questions

questions.question: How do I know if I'm a good candidate for aesthetic procedures?
questions.answer: A personal consultation with Dr. AlHasan is the first and most important step. Your health condition, aesthetic goals, and the most suitable options will be thoroughly evaluated.

questions.question: What is the recovery period after rhinoplasty?
questions.answer: Recovery time varies from patient to patient, but generally takes one to two weeks for initial recovery, with final results taking three to six months to fully develop.

questions.question: Are the results natural and long-lasting?
questions.answer: Yes, we adhere to international standards to achieve natural, refined results. Results are long-lasting when following medical advice and maintaining a healthy lifestyle.

questions.question: What is the cost of aesthetic procedures?
questions.answer: Costs vary depending on the procedure type and requirements. We offer a free consultation to evaluate your case and provide a detailed quotation.

questions.question: Can I return to work after the procedure?
questions.answer: Most procedures allow return to work within one to two weeks. This depends on the procedure type and individual recovery speed.
